sn1.35:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || 2.
sn1.35:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā Ujjhānasaññikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu. || Upasaṅkamitvā vekāsam aṭṭhaṃsu || 3.
sn1.35:1.3: Vehāsaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.35:3.1: yaṃ hi kayirā taṃ hi vade ||
sn1.35:3.2: yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade ||
sn1.35:6.1: Atha kho tā devatāyo pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā Bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn1.35:6.2: Accayo no bhante accagamā || yathā bālā yatha mūḷhā yathā akusalā yā mayaṃ Bhagavantaṃ asādetabbaṃ amaññimhā ||
sn1.35:6.3: tāsaṃ no bhante Bhagavā accayam accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā ti || || 5.
sn1.35:6.5: Atha kho tā devatāyo bhiyyosomattāya ujjhāyantiyo vehāsam abbhuggañchuṃ || || 7.
sn1.35:6.6: Ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imam gātham avoca || ||
sn1.35:9.4: ko ca dhīro sadā sato ti || ||
